intro: Reduce distractions and take control of Windows notifications. Winhance lets you customize which notifications you receive, silence unwanted alerts, and remove promotional content.

Additional Settings.blurb: Control promotional content and suggestions in notifications.
html:
Dependency Notice

Some settings in this section require the "Ads, Suggestions and Promotional Content" setting in Privacy & Security to be set to "Custom" before they can be modified.

groups.System Notifications: Control notifications from Windows system components.
groups.Privacy Notifications: Notifications related to privacy and app permissions.
groups.Security Notifications: Control security-related notifications from Windows Defender and Security Center.
